hints.title: Magnitude-Based Greedy Pairing
hints.text: Sort numbers by their absolute values so that every x is paired with 2 * x from smallest magnitude to largest.

hints.title: Frequency Counter Depletion
hints.text: Count frequencies of all numbers. For the smallest magnitude remaining number x, exactly count[x] occurrences of 2 * x must be available.

hints.title: Iterative Multiplicity Consumption
hints.text: Count frequencies into a map. Sort unique keys by abs(k). For each key k, if count[k] > count[2 * k], return false; otherwise decrement count[2 * k] by count[k]. Return true after all keys are processed.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Processing negative numbers in natural sorted order can mispair -4 before -2, failing to find a valid reordering.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting unique keys by absolute value takes O(U log U) where U <= N, and frequency checking runs in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that sorting by absolute value cleanly unifies positive and negative numbers without separate logic.
complexity.notes: Zero pairs with zero naturally since 2 * 0 = 0 and count must be even.
